headline: Owner equity hits
*a Q3 record*
slides.fig_caption: Equity held by U.S. mortgage holders, Q3 2026
slides.sub: Up 1.4% from a year ago, the highest third-quarter total on record.

slides.label: mortgage holders with *$1 million or more* in equity
slides.body: That count is up 6% from a year ago. Nearly 9 million owners now have at least $500,000 in equity, up 4%.

slides.title: Top states *after California*
slides.note: California alone accounts for *49%* of the national total.

slides.title: Equity is *on the move*
points: Cash-out loans: about 1 in 7 recent rate locks
Purchase loans: roughly 80% of rate locks
ARMs topped 10% of early October locks

slides.title: Past clients have *options*
slides.body: Owners hold record equity, even with high rates. A yearly home value check-in keeps you top of mind for the day they decide to move up, downsize or sell.
